faq.a1: Logo Dash is a professional logo management and display tool that helps you organize and showcase your brand logos effectively.
faq.a2: Simply drag and drop your logo files or click the upload button to select files from your device. Supported formats include PNG, JPG, SVG, and more.
faq.q3: Can I organize logos into categories?
faq.a3: Yes, Logo Dash allows you to create custom categories and tags to organize your logos efficiently.
faq.a4: All your logos are stored locally in your browser, ensuring complete privacy and security of your brand assets.
faq.a5: Yes, you can export individual logos or entire collections in various formats for easy sharing and backup.
